visual_action: The video displays a static graphic of a map of the United States, with 20 states colored in red. Text appears over the map. It then cuts to a close-up, still photograph of Donald Trump looking upward with a serious expression, with a quote attributed to him overlaid on the image.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A photo of him is shown with the overlaid text: "I'M PROUD TO HAVE DONE IT. Trump on overturning Roe v. Wade."

on_screen_text.text: After Roe was overturned, 20 states have limited or no abortion access.
I'M PROUD TO HAVE DONE IT.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; only a music track plays.
audio_music: An intense, dramatic song with female vocals, identified as 'LABOUR (the cacophony)' by Paris Paloma, plays throughout the clip, creating a serious and urgent tone.
editing_pacing: Slideshow style with a single cut between two static images.
cultural_references: Features the song 'LABOUR (the cacophony)' by Paris Paloma.
central_claim: Donald Trump is responsible for and proud of overturning Roe v. Wade, which has resulted in 20 states limiting or eliminating abortion access.
intended_effect: To create alarm and anger towards Donald Trump regarding his role in restricting abortion access.
